purpose: Two parts in one queue. Part C (confirmation required by the V18b rule): on hopper-kinematic-legjnt-medium, re-test the two groups that V18b screening found effective (MIXALL, BCMIX) against T and BC with 10 new seeds. Part Q (new hypothesis H_Q, screening): on the two walker2d thigh-joint tasks, where V18b mixing did not help and V20 found the source trajectories of lower quality than the target ones, keep only source trajectories whose recorded normalised return is at least the mean normalised return of the target trajectories, and test whether mixing them beats target-only training.
authorized_by_user: 2026-11-18: user asked for the next experiment to be prepared and will run it
excluded: hopper_kinematic_legjnt_hard/easy target files are byte-identical on the ODRL drive; their task cannot be established, so they are not used

groups.MIXVQ: source in V and Q (weight 1), policy from target only
groups.MIXALL: source in V, Q and policy (weight 1, own exp(10A) weights capped at 100)
groups.BCMIX: BC on target + BC on source, batch means added

source: D4RL medium from the transfer project, timeout rows dropped, recorded rewards and next observations, no relabelling or correction
score_normalization: ODRL reference returns (envs/infos.py); not comparable with the OTDF morph-task scores used before
learner: frozen network classes and loss functions (iql_dyn.py, iql_unc.py); IQL: gamma 0.99, tau 0.005, expectile 0.7, temperature 10, lr 3e-4, hidden 256, 64 target (+64 source) rows per step, policy cosine schedule; BC: lr 3e-4, hidden 256, cosine schedule; raw observations and rewards

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each
rule.strong_baseline: the better of T and BC by Last5 mean on that task (same seeds)
rule.effective: paired difference of a mixed group against the strong baseline (same seeds): mean > 0 and mean > 2 * paired SE
rule.part_C: MIXALL / BCMIX on hopper-kinematic-legjnt-medium is confirmed if it is effective over the 10 new seeds 2101-2110.
rule.part_Q: H_Q is supported on a task if MIXALLQ or BCMIXQ is effective there (5 seeds, screening; a supported group needs confirmation with new seeds). Comparisons of a filtered group with its unfiltered counterpart are descriptive. H_Q was formed after seeing V18b and V20.
rule.note: Rules are not changed after results are seen.

failure_policy: A run killed by a signal is restarted from step 0 with the same seed and config in a new folder, at most 3 times. A Python error, NaN/Inf or failed audit stops new launches and is reported. Returns are never used to decide a retry.
resource_revision: 2026-11-16, user request: a card another user is on may be joined when the whole card shows utilization <= 60% and at least 12000 MiB free, one new run per card per 90 s. Only the GPU admission rule differs from V18; tasks, groups, seeds, learner and decision rule are identical. V18 produced no training result (it was still waiting for a card when stopped).
quality_filter: Source trajectory segments are cut at terminals, timeouts and discontinuities (next_observations[i] != observations[i+1]). Each segment's return as recorded in the source data is normalised with the task's ODRL reference returns. The threshold is the mean normalised return of the target trajectory segments of the same task (computed from the target file the same way). Segments at or above the threshold are kept; timeout rows are then dropped as before. Only offline data are used; no simulator.

groups_note.MIXALLQ: MIXALL with the quality-filtered source data
groups_note.BCMIXQ: BCMIX with the quality-filtered source data
